column1: # What screen each level in the run pool ends on.
# Read from LevelManager.m_allLevelInterfaces in one frame at the title
# screen, via the DevTools "endings" command - no level is loaded, so
# every row is the authored value rather than one session of play.
# showRetryMenu is the one that matters: 1 means the three-button panel
# (restart / pause menu / next arrow), 0 means the run moves straight on.
# It is the GAME deciding, not the mod - see CHANGELOG 0.3.2.
